description: Rep. Dr. Jasmine Clark is a mom, microbiologist, and State Representative who found her passion for science and helping others at a young age. Inspired by her father, a doctor, and her mother, a nurse, she obtained a BS in Microbiology and PhD in Microbiology and Molecular Genetics from Emory University where she now serves as an Assistant Professor.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Jasmine Clark for Georgia bottom of page
title: Dr. Jasmine Clark | Mother. Scientist. Truth Teller.
